Findings from this lane (option A at 7b0ca538, reverted): (1) with stable copy ids a sync that changes nothing has no structure write and the run refuses it nothing_to_change, while 13 DS tests (one_undo_step..., undo_back_across_compactions..., redo_after_the_undo..., a_state_refused_after_the_sync..., both measured probes, three_hundred_syncs..., r1_*, detach_keeps_the_frame..., f6_a_stale_override..., a_native_state_whose_children..., a_sync_moves_an_explicit_mode...) expect every sync to be one history step (a no-op sync needs a defined step or success semantics; whether the run accepts identical entry bytes as a step is UNVERIFIED); (2) a_sync_with_no_room_for_its_states_is_refused_whole expects a sync to add states, which stable identity replaces (net 0); (3) r2_reopen_after_more_than_1024_instance_commands_keeps_working fails undo budget_exceeded under never-reuse ids, inferred (not instrumented) from the chronicle revision table (Budget.revisions 8192, hsk-studio-chronicle lib.rs:364-380, check near line 951) growing one address per fresh layer id; (4) the run refuses a delete and a create of one id in one transaction (duplicate_layer), so in-place update is the only stable-id redraw; (5) the delete paths other than delete_layer that leave raster_records rows (vector piece/pathfinder/knife replacements, design copy deletes, text conversions)

sd_proposals: STU-FX-103 / STU-FX-106 vs STU-RAS-103 / STU-RAS-104 / STU-RAS-106 (review F6, lead ruling Q2): STU-FX-103 defines an effect parameter record hsk.studio.effect_parameter@1 with a single bound_state per parameter (STU-FX-106), while STU-RAS-103..106 define hsk.studio.parameter_spec@1 with hard and soft bounds as separate values, each classified, and `unknown` as normative. A raster smart filter is both an effect (STU-FX-007) and a raster filter (STU-RAS-037), so both record shapes claim the same parameters. Proposal: STU-FX-103 references STU-RAS-103 for parameter bounds (one spec record), and STU-FX-106's bound_state becomes a projection of the STU-RAS-112 classifications. This lane emits only the STU-RAS record (lead ruling Q2); no Master Spec edit here.
